482.desc:
Funk Bomb: Sativa Hybrid | Grape Pie #2 x Gorilla Diesel #3
Breeder: Phylos Bioscience
Top Terpenes: Myrcene, Limonene, Alpha-Pinene
Funk Bomb lives up to its name with an unusually loud combination of sweet grape, sharp diesel, and earthy funk. Grape Pie #2 brings a ripe berry sweetness and subtle floral character, while Gorilla Diesel #3 adds pungent fuel, citrus peel, and skunky earth. The result is a bold, layered profile that starts with juicy grape and bright citrus before settling into a sour, gassy finish.
The effects lean energetic and cerebral, with an immediate mood lift followed by a focused, creative headspace. Funk Bomb tends to keep the body relatively light, making it better suited to daytime or social sessions than heavier, body-dominant cultivars. Myrcene gives the profile some earthy depth, while limonene and alpha-pinene reinforce the strain's bright citrus character and mentally stimulating edge.
